This record is governed by the
[Citlali Scientific Contract Library Program](../../../README.md) and must be

## Frozen Scope Boundary

SCI-ALIGN consumes exact native detector/readout and observing-state producer
facts, establishes one detector-reference slot/time relation, maps the paired
native `x/r` readout coordinates and registered fields onto that admitted grid,
and preserves mapping, source, timing, support, origin, response, uncertainty,
and provenance facts. Tune/readout retains the native `(I,Q) -> (x,r)`
authority. ALIGN does not author astrometric coordinates, calibration,
correlated-mode cleaning, MAP deposition, or downstream use eligibility.

The exact binding decisions, non-goals, open questions, and affected claims are
the entries in [`OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER.md`](OWNER_DECISION_REGISTER.md).
The exact shared downstream surface is
[`SCI-ALIGN_TO_SCI-AST_BOUNDARY.md`](SCI-ALIGN_TO_SCI-AST_BOUNDARY.md).

No implementation-derived scientific answer is admitted by this recovered
record.
